installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Node.js Generic Installation Script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server

set -e

export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get update -qq
apt-get install -y -qq git ca-certificates

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" == "true" ] || [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" == "1" ] || [ -z "${GIT_ADDRESS}" ]; then
    echo "Skip git clone (User Uploaded Files aktif atau Git Repo Address kosong)."
    echo "install complete"
    exit 0
fi

## add git ending if it's not on the address
if [[ ${GIT_ADDRESS} != *.git ]]; then
    GIT_ADDRESS=${GIT_ADDRESS}.git
fi

if [ -z "${USERNAME}" ] && [ -z "${ACCESS_TOKEN}" ]; then
    echo "using anon api call"
else
    GIT_ADDRESS="https://${USERNAME}:${ACCESS_TOKEN}@$(echo -e ${GIT_ADDRESS} | cut -d/ -f3-)"
fi

## cloudflared bawaan install sebelumnya tidak dihitung sebagai file user
EXISTING="$(ls -A /mnt/server | grep -vx -e cloudflared -e cloudflared.log || true)"

if [ -n "${EXISTING}" ]; then
    echo "/mnt/server directory is not empty."
    ORIGIN=""

    if [ -d .git ]; then
        echo ".git directory exists"

        if [ -f .git/config ]; then
            echo "loading info from git config"
            ORIGIN=$(git config --get remote.origin.url)
        else
            echo "files found with no git config"
            echo "closing out without touching things to not break anything"
            exit 10
        fi
    fi

    if [ -n "${ORIGIN}" ] && [ "${ORIGIN}" == "${GIT_ADDRESS}" ]; then
        echo "pulling latest from github"
        git pull
    else
        echo "no matching git repo found, skipping clone/pull"
    fi
else
    echo "/mnt/server is empty. cloning files into repo"
    rm -f /mnt/server/cloudflared /mnt/server/cloudflared.log

    if [ -z "${BRANCH}" ]; then
        echo "cloning default branch"
        git clone "${GIT_ADDRESS}" .
    else
        echo "cloning ${BRANCH}"
        git clone --single-branch --branch "${BRANCH}" "${GIT_ADDRESS}" .
    fi
fi

echo "install complete"
exit 0

variables.name: Git Repo Address
variables.description:
GitHub Repo to clone

I.E. https://github.com/user_name/repo_name

variables.name: Git Access Token
variables.description:
Password to use with git.

It's best practice to use a Personal Access Token.
https://github.com/settings/tokens
https://gitlab.com/-/profile/personal_access_tokens

variables.name: Command Run
variables.description: Command untuk menjalankan app. Kosongkan jika hanya ingin Shell Console (butuh Enable Shell Console = 1).

variables.name: Enable Cloudflare Tunnel
variables.description: Set 1 untuk mengaktifkan Cloudflare Tunnel (cloudflared bawaan image bimxyzdev). Set 0 untuk menonaktifkan. Default: 0.

variables.name: Cloudflare Tunnel Token
variables.description: Opsional. Kosongkan untuk menggunakan Quick Tunnel dengan URL *.trycloudflare.com. Isi token dari Cloudflare Named Tunnel untuk menggunakan domain custom yang sudah dikonfigurasi di Cloudflare.

variables.name: Additional NodeJS Packages
variables.description: Paket npm tambahan yang di-install (lokal di folder server) setiap startup, dipisah spasi. Kosongkan jika tidak perlu.

variables.name: Remove NodeJS Packages
variables.description: Paket npm yang di-uninstall setiap startup, dipisah spasi. Kosongkan jika tidak perlu.

variables.name: Enable Chromium (Puppeteer)
variables.description: Set 1 untuk memakai Chromium bawaan image bimxyzdev di puppeteer/whatsapp-web.js. Set 0 (default) untuk skip.

variables.name: Puppeteer Executable Path
variables.description: Path binary Chromium sistem untuk puppeteer. Kosongkan untuk auto-detect (/usr/bin/chromium). Hanya relevan jika Enable Chromium = 1.

variables.name: User Uploaded Files
variables.description: Set 1 jika file di-upload manual (skip git clone saat install). Git Repo Address kosong juga otomatis skip clone. Default: 0.

variables.name: Enable Shell Console
variables.description: Set 1 untuk mengaktifkan Shell Console: command di console dieksekusi sebagai bash dan server tidak berhenti saat app selesai/crash, hanya berhenti saat di-stop atau ketik exit. Default: 0.
